Name: Hanoch, Son of Reuben
Summary: Hanoch was a son of Reuben and a grandson of Jacob, named among the family that went into Egypt.
KeyStory: Hanoch is named first among Reuben's four sons.
RelatedPeople: Reuben; Phallu; Hezron, Son of Reuben; Carmi
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
